content.short: Solang provides a Solidity compiler for Solana and Substrate.
content.description: Solang is an open-source Solidity compiler designed for Solana and Substrate developers. It lets users compile their Solidity code and interact with the corresponding blockchains, providing a practical toolchain for building on these platforms. Supported by a team of 25 contributors, Solang has earned recognition as a go-to compiler within both Solana and Substrate ecosystems, delivering reliable compilation and interoperability across the chains.
